newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average closed up 4.62 points at 6,489.02 on Monday as investors wound up the year's business before the Christmas and New Year's holidays.
* Retail and information technology firm PT Multipolar Corporation will pay 673 billion rupiah in cash and notes for a 45 percent stake in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima, Matahari said on Monday.
* Industry and Trade Minister Tungky Ariwibowo estimated on Monday that exports of textiles and textile-related products in 1996 would be worth $6.8 billion, up 10 percent from last year.

* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 0.55 points, or 0.09 percent, to close at 633.07 on Monday on the back of active secondaries and a rise in heavyweight Telkom, but some profit-taking kept a cap on the index.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,363.40/63.80 in early trading against an opening of 2,363.25/64.00.
* Multipolar on the announcement it planned to buy a stake in Matahari.
* Footwear manufacturer Telagamas Pertiwi on the announcement it planned to buy a 100 percent stake worth 40.5 billion rupiah in distribution firm Artha Graha Wahana.
* Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia on reports of a plan to sell a 20 percent stake in PT Smith & Nephew Indonesia to Smith & Nephew (Overseas) Ltd.
* Voksel Electric on announcement that the firm had sold its 25 percent stake in PT Kawat Mas Prakasa.
